primary_source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
source_facts: For each ordered type-pair, the legacy completeness proof chooses one local representative mode before globally assembling Q.
If a suitable nonadjacent endpoint pair exists, Lemma 4 supplies a common Y0 neighbor and the proof chooses legacy 111.
If no such endpoint pair exists but a suitable T'-side Y0-neighbor exists with color different from f(T), the proof chooses legacy 001.
Otherwise the proof chooses legacy 000 and colors the corresponding Z-set with f(T).
After all local choices are made, Q, S(Q), Z(Q), and P_{Q,f'} are assembled globally.
The fixed extension c is used existentially in the completeness proof; it is not an oracle available to the enumeration algorithm.

scope: RAW representative selection, global assembly, and raw extension equivalence only.
forbidden: using an unknown extension c as an algorithmic oracle
automatic activation of any successor gate

fixed_extension_semantics.role_of_c: Existential witness used only in the completeness proof to identify one already-enumerated global state and one admissible coloring.
fixed_extension_semantics.algorithmic_firewall: The state family must be enumerable from P alone within the frozen polynomial budget; no construction step may query or infer c.

CASE_A_BAD_PAIR_EXISTS.condition: There exist nonadjacent p in Y(T) intersect N(Y0) and n in Y(T') intersect N(Y0) with c(p),c(n) notin f(T) union f(T').
CASE_A_BAD_PAIR_EXISTS.choose: A deterministic witness pair may be fixed for the proof; enumeration authority does not depend on this choice.

A1_COMMON.condition: There exists z in Y0 intersect N(p) intersect N(n).

A2_NO_COMMON.condition: Y0 intersect N(p) intersect N(n) is empty.
required_derived_relations: p-b notin E because otherwise b is a common Y0 neighbor
a-n notin E because otherwise a is a common Y0 neighbor
p-n notin E by bad-pair choice
a-b notin E: if a-b were an edge of Y0, p would be mixed on the Y0-edge ab, contradicting Lemma-11 input axiom (iv)
A2_NO_COMMON.parent_theorem_binding: Apply verified P7_CORRIDOR_RIGIDITY to obtain the canonical exact induced P6 certificate a-p-s-s'-n-b.
A2_NO_COMMON.color_binding: support colors are inherited from c for the completeness witness

CASE_B_NO_BAD_PAIR_BUT_001_WITNESS.condition: CASE A fails, and there exists n in Y(T') intersect N(Y0) with c(n) != f(T).

CASE_C_000.condition: Neither CASE A nor CASE B applies.
CASE_C_000.derived_color_fact: For every v in Y(T') intersect N(Y0), c(v)=f(T).
CASE_C_000.color_binding: f' on that Z-set equals f(T), hence agrees with c

COVERAGE_LOCAL.statement: For every ordered relevant type-pair and every fixed extension c, exactly one branch class A1/A2/B/C is applicable under the frozen priority order, and the selected object is a valid local state in the extended language.
COVERAGE_LOCAL.failure_output: smallest decorated (P,c,T,T') witness plus exact failed membership/derived relation

COVERAGE_GLOBAL_ASSEMBLY.statement: All selected local states can be united into one global Qhat. If a vertex appears in more than one local support component, its f' value is consistent because every selected value is inherited from the same fixed extension c.
additional_obligations: global support is the union of local support projections
global Z is the union of local Z-selectors
the assembled f union f' is proper because it is the restriction of c on the completeness witness

COVERAGE_POLY_CONSTRUCTIBLE.statement: The algorithm enumerates the complete polynomial candidate family independently of c; completeness only proves that one member of this family equals the existentially selected Qhat_c.

raw_equivalence_target.formula: Ext(P) iff OR_{Qhat, f' in Adm(Qhat)} Ext(P_{Qhat,f'})

RAW_COMPLETENESS.statement: Given c in Ext(P), the per-type decision tree defines Qhat_c. Let f'_c be c restricted to S(Qhat_c) union Z(Qhat_c). Then f'_c is admissible and c extends P_{Qhat_c,f'_c}.
RAW_COMPLETENESS.legacy_branches: Use the original 000/001/111 completeness reasoning unchanged.
split4_branch: support colors p,a,b,n are inherited from c
f union f'_c is proper on the enlarged precolored induced subgraph because c is proper
the local SPLIT4 membership and rigidity certificate are supplied by CASE A2

RAW_SOUNDNESS.statement: If d extends a generated raw P_{Qhat,f'}, then d extends the original P.
RAW_SOUNDNESS.proof_shape: The raw constructor keeps the same graph and original precolored assignments and only fixes additional vertices/reclassifies partition sets; no original coloring constraint is removed.

witness_carrying_failure_rule: No bare boolean failure. Return the smallest available decorated witness, exact ordered type-pair, branch, graph relations, color values, and first failed inference.
next_allowed_action: Implement or formally prove only this raw coverage/equivalence gate in a separate execution lineage after explicit authorization. Do not touch downstream transfers.
